row.name: Danger Sense
row.description: You possess an instinctive ability to detect impending threats or danger. The GM will secretly roll against your Perception in situations involving ambushes, disasters, or similar hazards. On a success, you receive enough warning to take action. A roll of 3 or 4 provides additional detail about the danger. This early warning system primarily serves self-preservation, allowing you to react quickly whether to save allies or simply escape a trap. (See Chapter 4: Advantages in the handbook for full details.) Note: While a general advantage, for Force-sensitives, this often manifests as a subtle Force premonition. Prerequisite: Force Sensitive (if taken as a Force-related advantage, representing a Force-user's sensitivity to danger through the Force).

row.name: Field Detection (Miraluka)
row.description: Miraluka's intrinsic connection to the Force grants them an exceptional ability to perceive, analyze, and interact with energy fields. When a Miraluka character attempts a skill check to perceive, analyze, or interact with an energy field, their Field Detection ability grants them a significant mechanical advantage. Grant a +3 to +5 bonus to the Miraluka's relevant skill roll (e.g., Perception, Electronics Operation, Energy Weapon (Beam), or a specialized Force-related skill) when they are actively using Field Detection in an appropriate scenario. The specific bonus can be adjusted by the GM based on the complexity of the task or the Miraluka's Force sensitivity. This ability makes them expert saboteurs, security bypassers, or mechanics, capable of manipulating energy systems for various ends. Cost range: 5 points (Basic).

row.name: Force Sensitive (Racial Trait)
row.description: Some species are naturally attuned to the Force.

row.name: Force Sight (Miraluka Specialized Vision)
row.description: Miraluka do not perceive light, but instead "see" via their connection to the Force. This unique form of perception allows them to bypass many conventional visual obstructions such as darkness, smoke, and even some non-Force-resistant solid objects at close range (at the GM's discretion, based on the Miraluka's Force sensitivity). Effect for Miraluka: Miraluka characters possess an inherent and passive form of Force Sight as a racial trait. They always perceive the world through the Force and intrinsically possess 360-degree vision. For Miraluka, using their Force Sight does not cost Force Points (FP). Purchasing levels in the Force Sight Power (as detailed in Chapter 8: Force Powers) for a Miraluka primarily enhances the range and specific Force-related perceptive abilities of their natural Force Sight, rather than granting the basic ability to "see" through the Force. This unique vision allows for unparalleled situational awareness, making them superb scouts, spies, or tactical commanders, regardless of loyalty.

row.name: Force Training
row.description: Force Training 1 (Adept). Benefit: You unlock the ability to learn Adept tier Force Powers. You also gain a permanent +1 bonus to your maximum Force Points (FP).

row.name: Language Talent
row.description: You have an ear for language. Every language you buy with points is spoken one fluency step higher than the level you paid for (Broken speaks as Accented, Accented as Fluent). Languages granted free - a native tongue, Bilingual, Polyglot - are unaffected. Facilitates espionage, trade, or communication with obscure factions across the diverse galaxy.

row.name: Jedi Equipped
row.description: Gift from the Order; includes Lightsaber Construction at IQ level.

row.name: Blind (Non-Conventional)
row.description: While Miraluka do not possess physical eyes and perceive the world through the Force, they are still considered "blind" in the conventional sense. This means they cannot see by means of light. They rely entirely on their Force Sight for perception. In areas where the Force is significantly diminished or nullified (e.g., a ysalimiri void), a Miraluka would be truly blind and severely impaired, relying on other senses or technological aids. This is typically a 0-point racial disadvantage because their Force Sight largely compensates for it, but the vulnerability remains.

row.name: Jedi Code of Honor
row.description: You are bound by the strict tenets of the Jedi Order (e.g., "There is no emotion, there is peace. There is no ignorance, there is knowledge. There is no passion, there is serenity. There is no chaos, there is harmony. There is no death, there is the Force."). This code demands unwavering discipline, emotional detachment, and often non-intervention unless necessary for galactic balance. This can be a significant burden in the morally ambiguous Mandalorian Wars, forcing difficult choices, forbidding expedient actions, or even requiring inaction when personal feelings or practical needs conflict with the Order's rigid dogma. Breaking this code results in severe psychological distress and potential expulsion from the Order, impacting your Force abilities.

row.name: Broad-minded
row.description: You are exceptionally open to new ideas, cultures, and alien customs, rarely passing judgment.

row.name: Miralukan Force Sight
row.description: The Miralukan species is a force sensitive humanoid race born without eyes, who perceive the world through the Force. This aids them in bypassing blindness, illusions, or even physical obstructions like smoke, darkness, or physical objects.
row.requirements: Required Advantage: Force Sight (Miraluka Specialized Vision)
row.effect: You can perceive the world through the Force in 360 vision, bypassing blindness, illusions, and normal darkness within 50 feet.

row.name: Force Heal
row.description: The Force-user channels life-giving energy through the Force to accelerate natural healing.
row.effect: Stabilize a dying character or remove 1 point of injury penalty.

row.name: Force Mind Trick
row.description: The Force-user subtly influences the minds of others, planting suggestions, causing confusion, or altering perceptions.
row.effect: Plant a simple, non-harmful suggestion in one non-Force-sensitive being within 5 feet. Requires a Quick Contest of skill vs. Will.

row.name: Jedi Robes (Cloak)
row.notes: Part of Jedi Robes Ensemble. Includes a hood.
row.effects: Part of the Jedi Robes Ensemble; +1 FP even without the rest. Usually tan, cream or brown -- color is the player’s choice.
row.baseDRNotes: Part of Jedi Robes Ensemble. Includes a hood.

row.name: Yellow Kyber
row.effect: 5d base energy. +1 to Force Points. Natural.

template.description: A Miraluka Jedi Consular who argues for negotiation over the blade. Ready-to-play character.
